class.name: SteamFriend
class.brief_description: A cached snapshot of one Steam friend.
class.description: Get snapshots from [method SteamFriends.list]. They remain readable after the Steam client stops.

method.name: get_display_name
method.description: Returns the cached Steam persona name, or an empty string if unavailable.

method.name: get_steam_id
method.description: Returns the full SteamID64 as a decimal string.

method.name: is_online
method.description: Returns whether Steam presented the friend as online at snapshot time.

members.member: Cached Steam persona name. An empty string means Steam supplied no name.
Whether Steam presented the friend as online when this snapshot was taken. Use a new list read to refresh it.
Full decimal SteamID64 used by Steam friend actions.
